rows.validation: Reject malformed RIFF boundaries, unsupported schemas, fields extending outside their instance, overflowing relative pointers, duplicate catalog records and excessive counts. Preserve all scalar rule values from installed EBX.
rows.contentPolicy: Read selected EBX and its installed decoder directly from the companion installation. Keep rules in memory; never write extracted game content or a trick catalog.

id.evidence: Unique reader configuration identifier; no game catalog values are embedded.

bundleName.evidence: Installed-file diagnostic found this bundle and decoded 363 scorable records.

assetPrefix.evidence: Bounded catalog scan selects this prefix from the installed bundle manifest.

installGroup.evidence: Installed-file diagnostic resolved every selected scorable to this install group.

decoderFile.evidence: Installed-file diagnostic successfully used the decoder in the player's skate installation, in place.

maxPayloadBytes.evidence: Deliberate parser resource budget of 64 MiB per payload; specifies the bound, not in-game performance.

maxCatalogEntries.evidence: Deliberate result budget; the audited installed catalog contains 363 records below this cap.

maxStringBytes.evidence: Deliberate metadata-string budget; all audited records fit below this cap.

validation.evidence: Parser validation contract for source implementation and diagnostic tests; gameplay remains separately unverified.
